app.title: Yufa | ToS Classic
app.subtitle: Tree of Savior Classic
hero.title: Tree of Savior
install.title: Install the game
install.intro: Pick where Tree of Savior Classic goes. The launcher downloads everything and keeps it updated.
install.resumeIntro: The last download into this folder did not finish. Finished files are kept; only the rest is fetched.
install.problem.invalid: Type a full path, like C:\Hyped Games\ToS Classic.
install.problem.forbidden: Program Files and Windows folders are not allowed. Pick a folder like C:\Hyped Games\ToS Classic.
install.problem.not-writable: No permission to write here. Pick another folder or drive.
install.problem.not-enough-space: Not enough free space on this drive.
install.problem.no-manifest: Could not reach the update server to size the download. Try again.
install.partialHint: An unfinished install was found here — it will continue from where it stopped.
install.completeHint: A game install was found here — it will be checked and updated.
status.runtimes.installing: Installing Windows runtimes — accept the administrator prompt (one time only)
news.title: News
settings.title: Settings
settings.invalidPath: No game install found there: the folder needs release\Yuka.exe or a previous launcher install.
settings.allowOffline: Allow playing while the update server is unreachable
settings.hardwareAccelerationHint: Draws the launcher window with the graphics card. Turn it off if the window goes black or flickers. The game is not affected.
settings.restartRequired: Takes effect the next time the launcher starts.
settings.amdFixHint: Puts DXVK's d3d9.dll next to the game so it renders through Vulkan instead of Direct3D 9, which misbehaves on current AMD drivers.
settings.amdFixNoAdapter: No AMD graphics adapter detected on this machine.
settings.amdFixAttribution: DXVK {{version}} by Philip Rebohle and contributors, zlib license. Its LICENSE file ships with the launcher.
settings.repairHint: Re-checks every downloaded patch and re-downloads anything corrupted.
settings.checkRuntimesHint: Installs Visual C++ 2015+ (x86) and DirectX (June 2010) if missing. Asks for administrator permission once.
error.offline: Could not check for updates. Check your connection.
error.offlinePlayable: You can still play with the current files.
error.manifest-invalid: The update server returned something unexpected. Try again later.
error.launcher-outdated: A newer launcher version is required to continue.
error.disk-full: Not enough disk space for the update.
error.file-locked: A game file is in use. Close the game (and antivirus) and try again.
error.game-running: The game is running. Close it to update.
error.manifest-cdn-desync: The patch server is being updated right now. Try again in a moment.
error.bad-game-path: Game folder not found. Set it in Settings.
error.patch-dir-readonly: No permission to write into the game folder.
error.av-suspected: Your antivirus may have blocked a game file. Add the game folder to its exclusions.
error.elevation-declined: The game needs administrator permission to start. Accept the Windows prompt and try again.
error.foreign-dll: A d3d9.dll the launcher did not install is in the game folder. It was left alone.
error.dxvk-failed: The AMD compatibility fix could not be applied.
error.busy: The launcher is busy with an update. Try again in a moment.
dxvk.warning: The AMD compatibility fix is on but could not be applied. The game will start without it.
dxvk.reason.foreign-dll: A d3d9.dll the launcher did not install is in release\. Remove it by hand if you want the fix, or keep it if you put it there.
dxvk.reason.game-running: The game is running. The fix is applied the next time the launcher is ready.
dxvk.reason.file-locked: The file is in use. Close the game (and antivirus) and check again.
dxvk.reason.busy: An update is running. Try again once it finishes.
dxvk.reason.failed: See the log folder for details.
dxvk.prompt.title: AMD graphics card detected
dxvk.prompt.body: Tree of Savior Classic can render wrong or slowly on AMD cards. The launcher can place DXVK's d3d9.dll next to the game so it renders through Vulkan instead. Nothing else in the game folder changes.
dxvk.prompt.later: You can turn this on or off at any time under Settings.
dxvk.refusal.foreign-dll: A d3d9.dll the launcher did not install is already in release\. It was left alone. Remove it by hand if you want the fix, or keep it if you put it there.
dxvk.refusal.game-running: The game is running. Close it and try again.
redist.warning: Windows runtimes could not be installed ({{runtimes}}). The game may not start; use “Check Windows runtimes” in Settings to try again.
redist.reason.failed: The installer did not finish. See the log folder for details.
